page_title: BAY 8-1 WOL | Bayern Munich v Wolfsburg 11/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
90+3' Felipe Chavez floats over the corner and Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
90+3' Felipe Chavez (Bayern Munich) will take a corner kick.
90+2' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+2' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 6:6.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 8 - 1 GOAL! Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) finds the back of the net from close in from a very acute angle.
86' It is time for a substitution. Pharell Hensel (Wolfsburg) is on for Christian Eriksen.
86' Daniel Bauer decides to make a substitution. Dzenan Pejcinovic will be replaced by Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Felipe Chavez (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Michael Olise cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
80' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) causes Manuel Neuer little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
79' That was close by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
79' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich).
79' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayern Munich get a corner.
77' Substitution. Dayot Upamecano makes his way off the pitch and Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
77' Here is a change. Harry Kane is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Wisdom Mike (Bayern Munich).
77' Substitution. Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) on for Lovro Majer.
76' 7 - 1 Goal! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Luis Diaz, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 7:1.
74' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.

73' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Wolfsburg will take a corner.

72' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Kamil Grabara, who tips the ball around the post.
71' 11:7 – the total goal attempt statistics. 7:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

69' 6 - 1 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Luis Diaz. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the top right corner via the woodwork. 6:1!

68' 5 - 1 GOAL! Harry Kane finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 5:1.

66' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by the excellent Manuel Neuer.
64' A substitution has been made. Patrick Wimmer goes off and Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) comes on.
64' Daniel Bauer prepares a substitution. Mattias Svanberg is replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
64' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
62' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

60' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a brilliant save.
60' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
59' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
58' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) replacing Aleksandar Pavlovic.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lennart Karl departs the field of play to be replaced by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich).
53' 4 - 1 This is definitely not what Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 4:1.

50' 3 - 1 Goal! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the left post. Kamil Grabara had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:1.
49' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

48' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Kamil Grabara is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.

47' Jonathan Tah sprays a wonderful pass out to Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Kamil Grabara problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
47' The referee awards a corner and Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.
46' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a precise pass into the box, but Konrad Laimer loses the one-on-one with the defender.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The referee is firm and issues Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) a deserved yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
44' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Kamil Grabara comes off his line to gather the ball.
43' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

43' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
42' Half-chance! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Kamil Grabara reacts well to snuff out the attack.
39' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Kamil Grabara makes a great save to stop his effort.

36' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Michael Olise, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
35' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is able to continue to play.
34' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Total attempts – 3:5. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.

30' 2 - 1 Michael Olise produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:1.
27' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
26' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
25' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
25' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.

24' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Bayern Munich, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
23' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
23' Dzenan Pejcinovic picks out Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg), who drives a shot just over the crossbar from the edge of the box.
18' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
17' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

16' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
16' 63:37 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
13' 1 - 1 It's 1:1! Lovro Majer feeds Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
12' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
11' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and it's Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
10' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) controls a cross from Michael Olise inside the box, but sidefoots the ball just wide of the right post.
9' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
7' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) sends a long ball forward to Michael Olise, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
5' 1 - 0 Own goal! Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 1:0.
5' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
3' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
